The paper evaluates generated text outputs from machine translation and summarization systems using various metrics, focusing on similarity to reference or source texts.

quote: We analyze different evaluation metrics by calculating their score for sentence pairs.
We consider the following reference-based metrics. • BERTScore ... • MoverScore ... • BLEURT ... • SBERT ... • SBERT-WK ... • mSBERT ... • MUSE ... • LaBSE ... • LASER ... • XMoverScore ...
Traditional evaluation metrics in machine translation and summarization, BLEU and ROUGE , have measured lexical n-gram overlap between system prediction and a human reference.

Humans have rated the similarity between human reference and MT hypothesis using so-called 'direct assessment' (DA) scores which are framed in terms of one sentence 'adequately expressing the meaning' of another.
